observation.command: echo "=== pnpm store size ==="; du -sh /root/.local/share/pnpm 2>/dev/null; ls /root/.local/share/pnpm 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== is pnpm store a global cache? ==="; du -sh ~/.pnpm-store 2>/dev/null; echo "=== how many workspace projects ==="; cd /workspace/app && cat pnpm-workspace.yaml | grep -cE "^\s+-" ; echo "=== measure real tarball throughput (a few) ==="; for p in "rxjs/-/rxjs-7.8.2.tgz" "zone.js/-/zone.js-0.15.1.tgz"; do curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "  $p : http=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download} time=%{time_total}s speed=%{speed_download}B/s\n" --max-time 90 "https://registry.npmjs.org/$p" 2>&1; done
